=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/claude_issue_route.py lines 60-61 (module docstring, "Routing order (first match wins):" item 6) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The docstring says the empty and invalid-value branches of AI_ISSUE_IMPLEMENTER fall back to claude. After this PR, DEFAULT_IMPLEMENTER is IMPLEMENTER_CODEX, so normalize_implementer_var (called for the empty string at line 50 of the test and the invalid string at line 53) returns codex for both branches; only the explicit "claude" literal still returns claude. The docstring now reads the opposite of what the code does.
  WHY: route_issue is the canonical contract every caller relies on; the docstring is the first place a maintainer looks when reading the routing logic. With the docstring still describing the old default, a future maintainer writing tests, callers, or documentation against it would build against a behaviour that does not exist. The new tests at lines 47-53 already lock in the codex fallback for both branches, so the docstring is the only artifact that disagrees with the implementation.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "README.md and agents.md: the default is documented as `codex`" (PR description, summary bullet 4).
  Expected change site: README.md, "Claude issue implementer" section, line 1216-1218 — the prose introducing the Claude issue implementer still describes Claude as the default. `agents.md` itself was updated, but `README.md` still says standalone issues are implemented by Claude Code by default.
  Evidence of absence: README.md lines 1216-1218 read "Standalone issues — anything the AI orchestrator does not manage — are implemented by **Claude Code** by default, in every repository that runs `ai-clarify.yml` (every install profile). Claude runs the same staged process as `/implement-plan-claude`, sized to one issue." The diff only touches README.md at lines 1142, 1233, 1321, and 2074; the 1216-1218 paragraph is not in any hunk. The diff also lacks a hunk that flips the lead sentence "Standalone issues default to the Claude issue implementer; …" at agents.md line 242 — the touched line changes a later clause, but agents.md also still describes Claude as the default at other sites (see TASK_GAP entries below). Both files therefore contradict the new default documented elsewhere in the README and in the changelog fragment.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Phase 0 (freeze) of the plan retires the Claude default; the PR commits to flipping `DEFAULT_IMPLEMENTER` from `claude` to `codex` and updating the documentation that still says the default is Claude." (PR description intent.)
  Expected change site: Every other in-repo artifact that documents routing to Claude as the default.
  Evidence of absence: Six locations still describe Claude as the default and are not in any hunk of the PR diff: (1) `.github/workflows/clarify.yml` lines 415-417, comment block `# Standalone issues default to the Claude issue implementer; set the repo variable to \`codex\` to keep the Codex clarify → plan → implement pipeline. Per-issue \`ai:codex\` / \`ai:claude\` labels win.` — the diff only touched line 488 (the warning text) and missed the comment; (2) `.github/workflows/claude-issue-intake.yml` line 11, comment `to Claude (the default; AI_ISSUE_IMPLEMENTER=codex switches a repo back).`; (3) `scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh` line 7, comment `(the default; see AI_ISSUE_IMPLEMENTER)` and line 121, comment `To send every new issue in this repo to Codex, set the repository variable \`AI_ISSUE_IMPLEMENTER=codex\`.`; (4) `.claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md` line 1, prose `That is the default; a repo switches with \`AI_ISSUE_IMPLEMENTER=codex\`, one issue with the \`ai:codex\` label.` — and the byte-identical mirror at `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md` line 1; (5) `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` line 75, prose `by default the Claude issue implementer (\`AI_ISSUE_IMPLEMENTER\`)` — and the byte-identical mirror at `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` line 75. None of these is in any hunk of the PR diff. After this PR, every one of them instructs a reader to expect Claude as the default; a `codex` reader (the new default) would still see instructions that tell them Claude is the default and to set `AI_ISSUE_IMPLEMENTER=codex` to opt back into Codex, exactly the inverted advice the Phase 0 plan set out to retire.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
